scientific_integrity: Complete analytic derivation and standalone exact-rational checker accompany this claim. Computational sampling corroborates but does not establish the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite focal-player group-size law with at most four prescribed sizes, all at least two, is necessary for the ordering theorem.
Five sizes already permit distinct probability laws with equal first three raw moments and different volunteering equilibria.
Deterministic well-mixed replicator dynamics, independent co-players, equal fixed benefits and costs, and absence of assortment and mutation are assumed.
The comparison is a mathematical application of classical divided differences; exhaustive historical priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Third-moment ordering of volunteer equilibria across four group sizes, with a five-size obstruction
